# Which lots did you really sell?

> Free crypto cost basis calculator. Paste your buys, sales and income as a CSV; it matches every sale to your lots under FIFO, LIFO, HIFO, LOFO or a tax-aware rule, compares the methods side by side and exports Form 8949 style rows. Runs in your browser; your history is never uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
